'''Caemlyn''' can refer to the following:

* [[Caemlyn]] - the capital city of [[Andor]].

== Chapters titles ==
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 35|Caemlyn]]'' - the thirty-fifth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 18|The Caemlyn Road]]'' - the eighteenth chapter of ''The Eye of the World''.
* ''[[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 45|Caemlyn]]'' - the forty-fifth chapter of ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 54|To Caemlyn]]'' - the fifty-fourth chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 7|The Streets of Caemlyn]]'' - the seventh chapter of ''[[Winter's Heart]]''.

=== Geography and Events ===
* The Caemlyn Gate - one of the three causeways connecting [[Far Madding]] to the mainland.
* The [[Royal Palace of Andor|Caemlyn Palace]] - another name for the Royal Palace of Andor.
* The [[Caemlyn Road]] - one of the major highways in the Westlands.
* ''Hai Caemlyn'' - the name of Caemlyn during the era of the [[Ten Nations]] and the [[Trolloc Wars]].
* The [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|Siege of Caemlyn]] - the turning point of the Fourth Succession War.
* The [[Fall of Caemlyn]] - the first battle of [[Tarmon Gai'don]] resulting in the destruction of the city.
